mapper.select: SELECT LMS_PRF_ID FROM LMS_PROFILE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT l.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, s.SEM_YEAR AS year, s.SEM_TERM AS termCode, l.LEC_VAL_STATUS AS lecValStatus FROM LECTURE l JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} ORDER BY s.SEM_ID DESC, lc.LEC_COD_NAME, l.LEC_ID
mapper.sql: SELECT u.LEC_UPL_ID AS uploadId, u.LEC_ID AS lecId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, s.SEM_YEAR AS year, s.SEM_TERM AS termCode, u.LEC_UPL_TITLE AS title, u.LEC_UPL_CONTENT AS content, TO_CHAR(u.LEC_UPL_REG_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS uploadedAt FROM LECTURE_UPLOADING u JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = u.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_UPLOADING u JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = u.LEC_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId}

SELECT DISTINCT s.SEM_YEAR AS year, s.SEM_TERM AS termCode FROM LECTURE_UPLOADING u JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = u.LEC_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} ORDER BY s.SEM_YEAR DESC

SELECT a.LEC_UPL_ID AS uploadId, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_ID AS attachmentId, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_EXT_TYPE AS fileExt, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_FIL_SIZE AS fileSize FROM LECTURE_UPLOADING_ATTACHMENT a WHERE a.LEC_UPL_ID IN #{id} AND a.ATT_VAL_STATUS = 'ACT' ORDER BY a.LEC_UPL_ID, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_REG_DATE, a.LEC_UPL_ATT_ID
